items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: The proprietor of the Hotel Bristol, Mr. Jensen, imposed a pianist on me.

ctx.x: It happened just once to me, way back in London, when I went to Oslo. The proprietor of the Hotel Bristol, Mr. Jensen, imposed a pianist on me. That was okay, it didn't make any difference. But this person, it so happened he was a, he was not a genial person.
